query:
SELECT 
  e.nome AS escola,
  e.inep,
  e.municipio,
  t.nome AS tecnico,
  os.qtdApInstalado AS aps_instalados,
  os.observacao AS rdo,
  DATE_FORMAT(os.dataConclusao, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') AS data_conclusao
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN escolas e ON e.id = os.escolaId
JOIN tecnicos t ON t.id = os.tecnicoId
WHERE os.status = 'concluida'
  AND os.observacao IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(os.observacao) != ''
ORDER BY os.dataConclusao DESC
LIMIT 20;
